name: SUNWAY
recent: Sunway 近期召开特别股东大会，通过设立最多占已发行股本10%的雇员认股计划（ESOS），并向包括创办人丹斯里 Jeffrey Cheah 在内的多名董事及高层分配认股期权。同期，雇员公积金局（EPF）连续多日申报持股变动。旗下 Sunway Construction 与 Sunway Healthcare 公布强劲季度业绩，前者订单创新高。
notable: 股东在特别股东大会通过设立最多占已发行股本10%的雇员认股计划（ESOS），并批准向多名董事及高层分配认股期权。
Sunway Construction 第三季净利按年增长25%至约1.05亿令吉，订单创下约124亿令吉纪录。
Sunway Healthcare 季度盈利大幅增长，券商上调其盈利预测。
risks: ESOS 最多可发行占已发行股本10%的新股，存在股权摊薄效应。
EPF 在多个交易日连续申报持股变动，显示大股东持股出现调整。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日季度，营收为29.06亿令吉，按年增长13.4%，按季增长13.6%；净利为3.19亿令吉，按年增长16.7%，但按季大幅下降96.6%，净利率为11.0%。

recent_en: Sunway recently held an EGM where shareholders approved an ESOS of up to 10% of issued shares and the allocation of options to directors including founder Tan Sri Jeffrey Cheah. In the same period, the EPF filed multiple consecutive changes in its substantial shareholder interest. Subsidiaries Sunway Construction and Sunway Healthcare reported strong quarterly results, with the former hitting a record order book.
notable_en: Shareholders at the EGM approved the establishment of an ESOS of up to 10% of issued shares and the allocation of options to several directors and key executives.
Sunway Construction's 3Q net profit rose 25% year-on-year to about RM105 million, with order book at a record of about RM12.4 billion.
Sunway Healthcare posted a sharp jump in quarterly profit, prompting a broker to raise its earnings forecasts.
risks_en: The ESOS may issue new shares of up to 10% of issued share capital, posing a dilution effect.
The EPF filed consecutive changes in its shareholding over multiple trading days, indicating adjustments in major shareholder holdings.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM2.906 billion, up 13.4% year-on-year and 13.6% quarter-on-quarter; net income was RM318.6 million, up 16.7% year-on-year but down 96.6% quarter-on-quarter, with a net margin of 11.0%.
